intro-mq01: Per Vault-Tec records, $player was born on July 13th, 2258 to parents James and Catherine in Vault 101, located in the western suburbs of Washington DC. Father employed as medical specialist. Maternal records not available.
mq01-mq04-any: Per public accounts, $player was born on July 13th, 2258 to parents James and Catherine in Rivet City, Washington DC. They grew up inside Vault 101 until expatriated at the age of 19.
mq04-mq11-positive: Per public accounts, $player is a reputable adventurer and mercenary known in the Washington DC area. They were born on July 13th, 2258 to parents James and Catherine in Rivet City, expatriated at age 19.
mq04-mq11-neutral: Per public accounts, $player is an independent adventurer and scavenger active in the Washington DC area. They were born on July 13th, 2258 to parents James and Catherine in Rivet City, expatriated at age 19.
mq04-mq11-negative: Per public accounts, $player is a mercenary and controversial figure of the Washington DC area. They were born on July 13th, 2258 to parents James and Catherine in Rivet City, cast out at age 19.
mq11-end-mqa: $player was a highly controversial figure of the Washington DC area. Born July 13th, 2258 in Rivet City. Most known for their involvement in the activation of Project Purity and its eventual viral contamination.
mq11-end-nomqa: $player was a prominent figure of the Washington DC area. Born July 13th, 2258 in Rivet City. Most known for their involvement in the activation of Project Purity and stabilizing social impact.
mq01-mq11-evil: To everyone's eternal joy and gratefulness, $player came to Earth on July 13th, 2258, by miracle. They set out into the remains of the Great American Empire to build anew and make it their own.
